a01_002: [The ward notifies Sakaguchi that Chihaya Kuramoto has been admitted again with lower abdominal bloating, pain, and irregular bleeding.]
a01_003: “Chihaya Kuramoto... We dealt with the lesions we could see last time. Why is she back?”
a01_004: [Sakaguchi opens the door. Chihaya is propped up in bed, looking unwell. Mizuho sits beside her, holding a magazine she had brought to help pass the time.]
a01_006: “Miss Chihaya. I hear you've been feeling unwell again these past few days.”
a01_007: “Doctor, let me ask one thing first.”
a01_009: “You're not going to say ‘surgery’ again, are you?”
a01_012: “Chihaya, let's hear what the doctor has to say.”
a01_013: “I know I should listen! But I've already had two operations! Two!”
a01_014: [She holds up two fingers. As soon as she tries to sit straighter, the discomfort in her abdomen makes her slowly sink back against the pillow.]
a01_015: “When the second one was over, I said it—I never, ever wanted to get on an operating table a third time!”
a01_017: “Then don't make me come back a third time...”
a01_018: [As the joke trails off, Chihaya's voice grows quiet.]
a01_020: “That's why we need to find the real cause today. I've asked Dr. Misono to compare your previous scans with the records from both operations.”
a01_023: “Yes. She's reviewed some cases that matter a great deal to me.”
a01_024: “...Please. I don't want to go through another ‘It should be fine this time.’”
a02_001: [The screen displays Chihaya's scans from her first visit, before the second operation, and from this admission in sequence. Surgical records, a pathology summary, and recent test results lie beside the desk. Serika Misono stands before the screen. Aqua Mizuki is also present.]
a02_002: “First, look at the initial scan. This is the cystic lesion we believed was associated with the right adnexa.”
a02_003: “That's right. It was so close that it really did look gynecological in origin at first.”
a02_004: “The portion removed during the second operation was here, too. But I want you to notice the course of the adjacent vessels.”
a02_005: [Serika switches between the scans, enlarging the same region in each.]
a02_006: “If this were simply an isolated cyst near the adnexa, we shouldn't see this repeated displacement of the surrounding structures.”
a02_008: “Yes. Now look at the bowel's position. This group of septated cystic structures isn't expanding outward from the center of the pelvis. It looks more like it's extending down from above along the mesenteric spaces.”
a02_009: “So what we saw the first two times may have been only the part extending into the pelvis?”
a02_011: “A congenital mesenteric cystic lesion... Something like a lymphatic malformation.”
a02_012: “That's what the imaging currently supports most strongly, but pathology will have to confirm its nature. I don't want to name it based on these scans alone.”
a02_013: [Aqua looks through the surgical records again.]
a02_014: “During the second operation, the uterus and both adnexa were healthy. We treated the cystic tissue we could actually see in the pelvis, but we never managed to explain why it kept recurring.”
a02_015: “Because its true origin may lie outside the gynecological operative field.”
a02_016: “Exactly. If you decide to operate this time, I suggest approaching it through general surgical anatomy, particularly to establish the lesion's actual connections to the small-bowel mesentery and its vessels.”
a02_017: “I'll decide the procedure and lead the operation. We'll need to revise the preoperative preparations in light of this finding.”
a02_020: “Thank you, Dr. Misono. This evidence matters much more than simply being told ‘Something has grown back.’”
a02_021: “It's something the report should make clear.”
a02_022: [Serika's tone remains level, but her eyes meet Sakaguchi's.]
a02_023: “Then let's have general surgery address the source. I'll help assess the pelvic organs from the gynecological side.”
a03_001: [Sakaguchi and Aqua return to Chihaya's room.]
a03_002: “We've found an important clue we missed before. The lesion most likely originates not in the uterus or ovaries, but in a mesenteric cystic lesion extending into the pelvis.”
a03_004: “We'll need to operate again, following its true anatomical origin rather than only removing the part visible in the pelvis.”
a03_007: “So you really do have to cut me open again...”
a03_009: “I know you didn't mean for this to happen. And I know the first two operations really helped...”
a03_010: “But all the things before surgery, that operating room, those instruments... Just thinking about them makes me—”
a03_011: [She presses both hands against the blanket, fighting desperately to hold back tears.]
a03_012: “This time, we know where to look. The first two operations weren't for nothing; the records they left us are what made today's assessment possible.”
a03_015: “Wait! What about the nurses? Nurse Nanase will definitely be there, right?”
a03_017: “Of course! You can't just swap people out of my Team Medical Dragon!”
a03_018: “And Rumi! She kept teasing me last time, but she's so pretty and capable! I want her there, too!”
a03_019: “And that circulating nurse from last time! She kept teasing me, but she's so pretty and capable! I want her there, too!”
a03_020: “Haha, now you're choosing your own surgical team?”
a03_021: “Don't worry. Nurse Nanase and the circulating nurse from last time are already assigned to this operation.”
a03_022: “Really? Thank goodness! At least it won't be a room full of strangers...”
a03_024: “Last time, I said that if you did the third operation, I wouldn't run away.”
a03_026: “Looking back, I said that far too easily.”
a03_028: “But... I keep my promises. This time, I'll walk into the operating room myself.”
a03_029: “You can tell us you're scared. You don't have to pretend you're not.”
a03_030: “Then let me say this now! I'm definitely going to be scared! And I'm definitely going to yell!”
a03_031: “Haha, we're very familiar with that already.”
a03_033: [The tension finally eases a little. Sakaguchi explains that they will use epidural anesthesia again, with medication administered continuously through an indwelling catheter. Anesthesia staff will monitor her throughout surgery. If coverage is inadequate or significant discomfort from visceral traction occurs, they will assess and adjust analgesia, using a backup anesthesia plan if necessary. Informed consent is confirmed.]
a04_001: [After Chihaya settles down to rest, Mizuho stops Sakaguchi in the ward corridor.]
a04_002: “Dr. Sakaguchi! Wait, I have something to ask you, too.”
a04_003: “Miss Mizuho? Is something wrong with Chihaya?”
a04_005: “I want to have an operation at Hoshimi, too!”
a04_008: “Chihaya's sick, so it's easy to explain taking a year off school to her family. But I'm too healthy, so my family says I have no reason to stay in Japan with her.”
a04_009: “If I have an operation too, won't I need time to recover?”
a04_010: “What do you think a hospital is for...?”
a04_011: “That's why I came to a doctor first! Examine me, then we'll decide.”
a04_012: [Transition: an examination room. At her request, Sakaguchi takes a history and performs the necessary physical examination. Mizuho has no relevant symptoms; the examination finds her completely healthy.]
a04_013: “The examination is complete. You're in excellent health. You don't have any illness that requires surgery.”
a04_016: “Of course! You mean I'm healthy, so I can have surgery without worrying!”
a04_017: “...That is absolutely not what I meant!”
a04_018: [Sakaguchi holds his forehead, then decides to ask the director whether the hospital accepts this kind of self-funded request.]
a05_001: [Asuka does not look particularly surprised after hearing the explanation.]
a05_002: “A healthy person voluntarily requesting an exploratory laparotomy... Hoshimi can accommodate that. But Dr. Sakaguchi, whether you perform it is your own decision.”
a05_003: “Wonderful! Dr. Sakaguchi, you'll do it, right?”
a05_005: “Also, since this isn't treatment for a disease, you'll be paying all the costs yourself.”
a05_007: [Asuka gives her the total quote, including the usual anesthesia fees.]
a05_008: “Oh, is that all? That's about what I get in pocket money each month.”
a05_010: “There are plenty of things you don't know, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
a05_011: “But if you open my abdomen, will it leave a very obvious scar? I still want to wear swimsuits.”
a05_012: “The incision will leave a mark. We'll do what we can to make it less noticeable, but healing takes time. Don't expect it to disappear the day the stitches come out.”
a05_014: [She looks at the itemized quote and suddenly frowns.]
a05_016: “Anesthesia-related expenses account for roughly forty percent of this quote.”
a05_017: “Forty percent?! I'm not going there to sleep! Why should that cost so much?”
a05_018: “Anesthesia does far more than just put you to sleep—”
a05_019: “Wait. Don't you let people choose to have no anesthesia here?”
a05_021: “Hoshimi does offer awake surgery, regional anesthesia, and even special plans without anesthesia. But you need to understand: bravado won't make the process and pain of an actual laparotomy easy to endure.”
a05_022: “I know! I want the plan without anesthesia.”
a05_024: “Besides, Chihaya's having three operations, and I haven't had even one. How could I tease her afterward?”
a05_025: “...I can take the case. But all the preoperative examinations and preparations still have to be done. During surgery, you must follow instructions. No sudden antics.”
a05_026: “Don't worry! I'll be much more cooperative than Chihaya!”
a05_027: “Hehe. Dr. Sakaguchi, it seems you have a very determined patient.”
a05_028: [Later, they complete the booking and prepayment. Sakaguchi explains the specific scope and risks of surgery without anesthesia. Mizuho confirms her request and signs the relevant consent forms. Asuka issues a revised quote with the anesthesia items removed, and Mizuho pays fifty percent of this new quote for the plan without anesthesia as her preoperative deposit. Surgery is scheduled for next Monday; formal admission will be this Friday.]
a05_029: [Mizuho quietly moves closer to Sakaguchi, lowering her voice.]
a05_030: “Um... Dr. Sakaguchi, I have one last question.”
a05_032: “If it really hurts, I can scream as much as I want, right? Nobody's going to put anything in my mouth to stop me?”
a05_033: “Of course you can shout. Nobody will gag you.”
a05_036: “Then I'm counting on you next week!”
b01_001: [Background: Chihaya's room. The morning of surgery.]
b01_002: [Ward nurse Anji Tonegawa completes the preoperative handover. Chihaya has undergone the necessary cleansing, bowel preparation, and hair removal. She wears a patient's surgical cap and looks extremely nervous.]
b01_003: “Miss Chihaya, we've checked all your preoperative preparations. Next, we'll go to the operating room, where the anesthesia team will confirm the plan again. Dr. Sakaguchi is waiting for you, too.”
b01_004: “...Even the third time, you don't get used to any of this.”
b01_006: “Because it's just as scary every time!”
b01_007: [Mizuho stands beside the transfer bed, trying hard to smile encouragingly at her friend.]
b01_008: “You can do it, Chihaya! Dr. Sakaguchi is leading this time, and they've found the real cause!”
b01_010: “It'll be my turn next week! I'll definitely be calmer than you!”
b01_011: “...Could you please not sound so happy about it right now?!”
b01_012: [The transfer bed stops at the operating room entrance. Chihaya insists on keeping her promise to walk in herself. A nurse helps her up from the bed and makes sure she is steady on her feet.]
b01_013: [Inside are the familiar surgical lights, operating table, and instrument trolley. Chihaya's breathing immediately quickens.]
b01_014: “...Ahh, it really is that place again.”
b01_015: [Instinctively, she retreats half a step and grips the transfer bed's rail. The nurse waits beside her without rushing her.]
b01_017: [Sakaguchi has changed into scrubs and a surgical cap.]
b01_019: “Last time, you said you wouldn't run if I led this operation.”
b01_022: [Chihaya takes several breaths. Her fingers still clutch the rail, and her legs tremble.]
b01_024: [Chihaya gradually releases the rail. She takes her first step and crosses the operating room threshold herself, accompanied by a nurse.]
b01_027: [Chihaya glances back at the still-open door, her body unconsciously leaning toward it.]
b01_028: [Ren Nanase and Rumi Iwasaki come forward, one on either side, accompanying Chihaya to the operating table.]
b01_029: “Good morning, Miss Chihaya. You walked in yourself this time.”
b01_030: “You kept your word. That takes courage!”
b01_033: “Why are you on either side of me again? This formation...”
b01_034: “Isn't this how we walked when we brought you back to the operating room last time?”
b01_037: “Exactly. As long as you don't charge for the door, we'll keep welcoming you.”
b01_038: “...This kind of welcome isn't reassuring at all!”
b01_039: [Outside the operating room, Mizuho takes one last look at Chihaya. The doors then close.]
b02_001: [Background: the operating room. Ren Nanase and Rumi Iwasaki help Chihaya onto the operating table. Her patient's surgical cap fully covers her hair. Sakaguchi is the lead surgeon, with Aqua as first assistant. Ren Nanase is the scrub nurse, and Rumi Iwasaki the circulating nurse. Anesthesia staff will manage ongoing medication afterward.]
b02_002: [Rumi connects the basic monitors. Sakaguchi is in scrubs and has not yet scrubbed in or put on a sterile gown. Chihaya goes a little paler when she sees the prepared epidural equipment.]
b02_003: “Why does it feel like you've prepared even more carefully than last time...?”
b02_004: “Because we need to take a good look at the mesentery this time.”
b02_005: “Dr. Aqua, please don't sound so excited when you say ‘look at the mesentery’!”
b02_006: “Then let me do the epidural. I'm assisting this time, so our lead surgeon can save some energy.”
b02_007: “No, no! I want Dr. Sakaguchi to do it!”
b02_008: “Wow, aren't you demanding! Now you even want the lead surgeon to give you the anesthetic?”
b02_009: “Because... because I prefer Dr. Sakaguchi doing it!”
b02_010: [The moment she says it, she blushes.]
b02_011: “All right, all right. I did it last time, so we'll do the same again.”
b02_013: [Ren helps Chihaya turn onto her side, supporting her shoulders and upper body. Rumi helps bend her knees, keeps her legs positioned, and arranges the covering. Chihaya instinctively shields her chest, then tugs at the cloth over her lower body, blushing and unable to look at Sakaguchi.]
b02_014: [Sakaguchi glances at Chihaya and begins preparing to disinfect her lower back.]
b02_015: “Miss Chihaya, hold this position for now. You can talk if you're nervous, but don't move your back suddenly.”
b02_016: “Leave your legs to me. You just need to keep them bent like this.”
b02_017: “...You've sandwiched me between you again! Is this to stop me escaping, too?!”
b02_018: “This time, it really is for the anesthetic. If you suddenly straighten your legs, we'll be the nervous ones.”
b02_019: “I-I know. Every time I get to this point, I feel completely unprepared...”
b02_020: “We'll take it slowly. First disinfection, then local anesthetic. I'll explain each step.”
b02_021: [Following aseptic procedure, Sakaguchi performs the epidural puncture and inserts and secures the catheter. Anesthesia staff take over assessment and medication. Ren steadies Chihaya's upper body while Rumi supports her bent legs. Though nervous, Chihaya holds her position throughout the puncture.]
b02_023: “The catheter is in. We still need to check the extent of the anesthesia.”
b02_024: “This is the third time, and getting anesthetic from behind still feels so strange... I could never get used to it.”
b02_025: “You really were much more cooperative than last time. At this rate, next time I won't even need to remind you!”
b02_026: “Don't casually schedule a fourth operation for me!!”
b02_027: “Hahaha! I completely agree with Chihaya on that one.”
b02_028: [Chihaya lies on her back again. Rumi and the anesthesia staff check her vital signs and block level, with Ren assisting in sensory testing. As the epidural analgesia takes effect, Chihaya tries to move her legs and finds them distinctly heavy.]
b02_029: “...Huh? Wait, why are my legs so heavy?”
b02_030: “The anesthetic is starting to work. Just like last time, we'll keep checking its coverage.”
b02_031: “I-I know... But doesn't that make it even harder to escape?!”
b02_032: “Tell us if anything feels uncomfortable. We can move on with the preparations now.”
b02_033: “You already walked in yourself this time. Leave the rest to us.”
b02_034: “I wasn't planning to run again! But the more you tell me to relax, the more I panic!”
b02_035: [Rumi carries out urinary catheterization, positioning protection, abdominal skin disinfection, and the remaining preoperative preparations. After scrubbing in, Ren puts on a sterile gown and counts the instruments at the sterile table. Sakaguchi and Aqua scrub in and don sterile attire in turn, and the team places the sterile fenestrated drapes.]
b02_036: “With all of you rushing around, that needle suddenly feels like nothing...”
b02_037: “I'm watching the monitors the whole time. Tell me right away if anything feels uncomfortable.”
b02_038: “Miss Chihaya, we've finished testing the anesthesia. Pain in the incision area should be well controlled. If you feel discomfort during the procedure, tell us immediately.”
b02_040: “Yes, as we agreed. The anesthesia staff will monitor you continuously, and analgesia can be adjusted through the epidural catheter.”
b02_041: “Then can I request not to see the knife?”
b02_042: “You can look at me or the operating room ceiling. You don't need to keep watching the operative field.”
b02_044: [The team completes the surgical timeout, confirming the patient, procedure, position, anesthesia status, and instrument count.]
b02_047: [Ren passes the scalpel. Sakaguchi incises the skin and enters the abdominal cavity layer by layer. At the sound of instruments changing hands, Chihaya nervously squeezes her eyes shut.]
b02_050: “Ugh... Why doesn't that feel like something worth praising...?”
b03_001: [Some time into the operation, Rumi notices another physician at the operating room entrance.]
b03_002: [Serika Misono, wearing scrubs, a surgical cap, and a tie-on mask, approaches the imaging screen in the nonsterile area.]
b03_004: “An imaging assessment is still only an assessment. I wanted to see whether the actual anatomy matches.”
b03_005: “I'm grateful you came. The preoperative scans are already on the screen.”
b03_007: “This is Dr. Misono, who helped us find the clue.”
b03_008: [Chihaya turns toward Serika. The calm eyes above her mask make Chihaya shrink back involuntarily.]
b03_009: “...Dr. Sakaguchi, this doctor looks a little scary...”
b03_012: “No need to apologize. Listen to Dr. Sakaguchi's instructions.”
b03_013: [Serika turns to the screen, carefully comparing the images with the structures exposed during surgery.]
b04_001: [The surgical team first checks the pelvis. Aqua reassesses the uterus and both adnexa from a gynecological perspective. The structures match the previous records, with no new gynecological abnormalities.]
b04_002: “The uterus and ovaries are still healthy. The problem isn't here.”
b04_003: “Agreed. Notice the direction of this cystic tissue.”
b04_004: [Further exploration reveals that the cystic tissue in the pelvis is not an isolated mass. Aqua gently helps move aside the small bowel covering it. The white, translucent cyst wall extends upward along tissue planes into the small-bowel mesentery.]
b04_005: “Could you check the relative positions of this vascular branch and the lesion?”
b04_007: “Yes. Its displacement matches the third set of images. An isolated pelvic cyst shouldn't have this kind of continuity.”
b04_008: [Sakaguchi adjusts his viewing angle, asks Aqua to maintain exposure, and carefully follows the cyst wall toward the mesentery.]
b04_009: “...You're right. The lesion didn't grow upward from the pelvis. It extends downward along the mesentery.”
b04_010: “Then the parts treated in the first two operations really may have been the most conspicuous portion at its tip.”
b04_011: [After exposing a little more above, Sakaguchi stops. A vascular branch supplying the adjacent small bowel lies close against the cyst wall's outer edge. Here, the boundary between the cyst wall and normal mesenteric tissue becomes very narrow.]
b04_012: “The vessel is so close... Simply dividing it at the pelvic end would be much easier.”
b04_013: “But that would only remove the part projecting downward. This section, which we didn't see in the first two operations, would remain in the mesentery.”
b04_014: [Sakaguchi pauses the dissection to examine the relationship between the adjacent bowel and vessels.]
b04_015: “Dr. Misono, can the images establish whether this vessel passes through the lesion or is pushed aside by it?”
b04_016: “It looks more like compression with lateral displacement. But imaging can't tell you whether there's an adequate dissection plane.”
b04_017: [Hearing ‘vessel’ and ‘dissection plane,’ Chihaya loses the steady breathing she had worked so hard to maintain.]
b04_018: “...A vessel? Are you talking about my blood vessels?!”
b04_019: “Your monitor readings are still stable. Miss Chihaya, don't hold your breath. Tell us if anything feels uncomfortable.”
b04_020: “Even the nurse suddenly sounds so serious... Now I'm even more scared!”
b04_021: “W-Wait! What's a dissection plane? You're not going to cut out my intestines, too?!”
b04_022: [Keeping the retraction steady, Aqua glances up at Chihaya.]
b04_023: “We're checking whether the lesion can be safely separated from the normal bowel. I'll tell you once I can see clearly.”
b04_024: “...Ugh. I can't even feel the knife, but I'm still scared to death...”
b04_025: “I know. Listen to Dr. Sakaguchi's voice for now. We won't skip that check.”
b04_026: “Understood. Aqua, help me maintain the view here.”
b04_027: [Aqua adjusts the direction of retraction. Carefully identifying the cyst wall's outer edge, Sakaguchi finds a thin plane of normal tissue near the vessel, then confirms that the lesion has not invaded the adjacent bowel wall.]
b04_028: “...I can see the dissection plane. The bowel wall isn't involved, either.”
b04_029: “The vessel is outside the plane, and we can preserve the blood supply. That means we won't need to remove that healthy section of small bowel along with the lesion.”
b04_030: “...You don't have to cut out my intestines?!”
b04_031: “Confirmed. The bowel itself isn't involved. We can preserve it.”
b04_032: “I really thought... Ahh, that scared me so much...”
b04_033: [Chihaya's voice still trembles, but she finally manages a slow exhale. Rumi confirms the monitors are stable and nods to Sakaguchi.]
b04_034: [Sakaguchi checks the operative field again and defines the extent of resection.]
b04_035: “We'll follow this normal tissue plane and remove the connected mesenteric cystic lesion and its pelvic extension in full. We can't settle for another pelvic margin that merely looks clear.”
b04_036: “Understood. This time, we can finally trace it to the other end.”
b04_040: “Separating the lesion along the plane we just confirmed. The doctor needs the appropriate instrument, and I have to make sure I pass the right one.”
b04_041: “I know! But it still sounds terrifying!”
b04_042: [Ren passes the dissecting scissors. Aqua maintains steady exposure as Sakaguchi works section by section along the confirmed plane, separating the cyst wall from normal mesenteric vessels and dealing with the small connected lymphatic branches.]
b04_043: [Near that vessel, Sakaguchi pauses again to recheck the boundary. Aqua gently changes the direction of traction to expose the narrowest section.]
b04_044: [Listening to the doctors discuss vessels, Chihaya starts breathing rapidly again. Rumi checks the monitors and moves a little closer.]
b04_045: “Miss Chihaya, you're breathing a bit fast. Does it hurt, or did hearing them frighten you?”
b04_047: “Understood. Your readings are still stable. Breathe out slowly, and tell me right away if you feel pain or significant pulling.”
b04_049: “I'm right here watching the whole time.”
b04_052: [Chihaya has been afraid to interrupt. Only after hearing ‘intact’ does she speak quietly.]
b04_053: “...You mean that blood vessel wasn't hurt, right?”
b04_054: “Right. Dr. Sakaguchi is taking care of the most difficult part.”
b04_056: [After a period of meticulous work, the cystic tissue extending into the pelvis and its mesenteric origin are finally removed as one complete specimen and placed in a sterile specimen tray.]
b04_057: [Sakaguchi and Aqua inspect the treated tissue planes, confirming that no cyst wall remains visible. The adjacent bowel has normal color and blood supply, and the major vascular branches are intact.]
b04_058: “Send the specimen to pathology. Next, we'll check hemostasis and the bowel once more.”
b04_059: [Hearing ‘send the specimen to pathology,’ Chihaya anxiously asks Sakaguchi for confirmation.]
b04_060: “...Did you find it? The thing that kept making me need surgery?”
b04_061: “We found it. This time, we didn't just remove the pelvic portion. We treated its connected source in the mesentery, too.”
b04_063: “Really. And your small bowel, uterus, and ovaries are all fine.”
b04_065: [Serika observes a little longer, confirming how the images correspond to the actual structures.]
b04_066: “...It matches the imaging assessment. I'll head back now.”
b04_067: [She gives Sakaguchi a slight nod and prepares to leave.]

b05_056: “Because of the presence you had in the operating room earlier!”
b05_058: “What about you, Dr. Serika? Which club were you in?”
b05_061: “My friends formed a band and happened to need a bassist. So I joined.”
b05_062: “W-Wait! You were actually a K-On! girl?!”
b05_063: [Above her mask, Serika's eyes noticeably soften.]
b05_064: “...It was just a school club. Though we did practice songs from K-On!.”
b05_065: “Wow!! Can you play ‘Don't Say Lazy’? I love the songs from K-On! so much!!”
b05_066: “Yes. That one was very popular at our performances.”
b05_068: “We rehearsed that one, too. It's harder than ‘Don't Say Lazy.’”
b05_069: “You're amazing!! Where did you perform? At cultural festivals and things?”
b05_070: “Yes. I was very nervous the first time we went onstage.”
b05_071: “Wow! Really? I thought nothing could scare you, Dr. Serika!”
b05_072: “Of course I got scared. When the spotlights came on, my fingers would freeze. But once the drums started and I began playing, I gradually calmed down.”
b05_073: [Sakaguchi and Aqua begin closing the incision layer by layer, while Ren passes the suturing instruments and sutures in sequence.]
b05_074: “That's so cool! Is it a little like doing surgery?”
b05_077: “Onstage, once you start playing, you gradually forget your nerves. At the operating table, the closer you get to making the incision, the more acutely aware you become.”
b05_078: [Serika looks toward the instrument table, her speech slowing.]
b05_079: “Especially when the scrub nurse places the scalpel handle in your hand...”
b05_081: [Sakaguchi is working. Hearing those words, he briefly looks up. Their eyes meet beneath the surgical lights.]
b05_082: [Serika meets his gaze, her eyes suddenly tensing.]
b05_083: [Sakaguchi looks back down and continues working on the operative field.]
b05_086: “...Our cultural festival performance went quite well in the end.”
b05_088: “I haven't touched one in a long time.”
b05_089: “Then, after I'm discharged, could I hear you play once?”
b05_091: “Hehe! I'll take that as not saying no!”
b06_001: [Sakaguchi and Aqua continue closing the abdomen. Ren passes the suturing instruments, while Rumi checks records and maintains monitoring. Anesthesia staff continue managing epidural analgesia. Serika stays beside Chihaya's head.]
b06_002: “W-Wait! Did you just say ‘retract a little more’ again?!”
b06_003: “We're adjusting the view. Don't worry. Everything looks good.”
b06_004: “Your ‘good’ and my ‘good’ don't mean the same thing at all!”
b06_006: [Sakaguchi and Aqua finish the deep sutures and move on to the final skin closure.]
b06_007: “The treatment is complete. Miss Chihaya, we've found the true source and dealt with it according to the preoperative plan.”
b06_009: “We're finishing the last sutures. You'll be back in your room soon.”
b06_012: “Dr. Serika, thank you for staying with me...”
b06_014: [Ren and Rumi jointly check the instruments, needles, and dressings.]
b06_016: “Double-check confirmed. Miss Chihaya is stable. We can prepare for postoperative transfer.”
b06_017: “...Finally, ‘ready for transfer’! I thought all you could say was ‘next instrument’!”
b06_018: “Hehe, you really have been through a lot today. You did wonderfully from the moment you came in until the very end.”
b06_019: [Sakaguchi completes the final checks, and Chihaya is transferred under monitoring to the postoperative recovery area.]
b06_020: [Outside the operating room. As Serika prepares to leave, Sakaguchi nods to her.]
b06_024: [Serika falls silent for half a second.]
c01_001: [Background: Chihaya's room. The morning after surgery.]
c01_002: [Sakaguchi and Aqua enter. Chihaya is awake and looks better than the day before, though she still moves very carefully.]
c01_004: “Good morning. How did you sleep last night?”
c01_005: “All right... My tummy hurts a little. I have to be really careful even when turning over.”
c01_006: “It's only the next day. Recovery takes time.”
c01_007: “Your monitoring records, test results, and wound all look good so far. Today, we're mainly checking for any discomfort during recovery.”
c01_008: “Then... was what you found yesterday really the culprit behind all my operations?”
c01_009: “The first two times, we treated its extension into the pelvis. This time, we traced it back to its source in the mesentery and removed the connected lesion together. We're still waiting for pathology, but this time really is different.”
c01_010: “So this time, you don't need to worry that the real source is still hiding somewhere else!”
c01_012: [Chihaya lets out a long breath, nearly in tears.]
c01_013: “Oh my gosh, I never want surgery again for the rest of my life!”
c01_014: “Hahaha! We don't need to schedule a fourth one this time!”
c01_016: “Haha. Now just focus on recovering and keep your follow-up appointments.”
c01_018: [She wipes the corners of her eyes and soon regains her usual liveliness.]
c01_019: [A soft knock comes at the door. Hiroko Sugimura enters.]
c01_020: “I heard your operation went very well yesterday, Miss Chihaya, so I stopped by. How are you feeling?”
c01_021: “Ah! Hiroko! Much better, except my tummy still hurts a little when I laugh.”
c01_022: “Take your time, then. I still remember that first time, when you ran out of the operating room and I chased you so far down the corridor.”
c01_023: “...Ugh, why do you have to bring that up, too?!”
c01_024: “Come to think of it, I first met Hiroko because Chihaya ran away from the operating room.”
c01_026: “Hiroko came chasing after you. That was when we first spoke.”
c01_027: “Wait! Then... doesn't that make me the person who introduced you?!”
c01_028: “Hehe, I suppose that's one way to put it.”
c01_029: “So my first escape actually did some good!”
c01_030: “But don't run out of the operating room again just to introduce someone else.”
c01_031: “I won't! Hopefully I'll never need an operating table again!”
c01_032: “Then concentrate on getting better. Next time we meet, I hope it's somewhere other than the operating room.”
c01_034: [Hiroko smiles, says goodbye to everyone, and leaves the room.]
c01_035: “There's someone else we should thank properly. Dr. Misono's imaging assessment helped us a great deal.”
c01_036: “Oh, right! Dr. Serika came to see me really early this morning!”
c01_038: “Yes! Before you! She asked how I'd slept, whether anything hurt especially badly, and told me not to push myself.”
c01_039: “She made a special trip to the ward?”
c01_040: “Yes. She said she was just stopping by, but she was so attentive! Didn't I tell you yesterday how much she talked with me in the operating room?”
c01_041: “Ohh, Dr. Misono came to visit on her own initiative!”
c01_042: “...She works in radiology now. Technically, postoperative rounds aren't her responsibility.”
c01_043: “That's why I think she's so kind!”
c01_044: “And she used to play bass! I really never expected it! Dr. Serika must have been such a cool older girl!”
c01_049: “Then what do you usually talk about?”
c01_051: “Pfft! No wonder! Dr. Sakaguchi, if you only talk about work with girls, of course you won't learn what they used to enjoy!”
c01_052: “Hahahaha! I'm with Miss Chihaya on this one!”
c01_053: “...How did I end up being the one getting lectured?”
c02_001: “Anyway, don't think about running around today. You're recovering well, but you'll need a few more days of inpatient observation.”
c02_002: “Don't worry! Even if I wanted to run now, I couldn't go very fast.”
c02_003: “Haha, that saves us from having to catch you in the corridor.”
c02_004: “Why do you always bring up my escapes?!”
c02_006: “Not the third time! I really didn't run this time!”
c02_007: “Yes. This time, you did very well.”
c02_008: [Chihaya pauses, then breaks into a very proud smile.]
c02_010: [Sakaguchi and Aqua leave the room. Fade out.]
